tagline: Out of Mayberry and around the mountains away from the mountains.
intro: The drive starts on Main Street in Mount Airy, Andy Griffith's hometown and the town taken to be Mayberry, and heads east into the Sauratown Mountains. They are a small, isolated range of quartzite knobs standing up out of the rolling northern Piedmont, apart from the Blue Ridge, and they are sometimes called the mountains away from the mountains. Hanging Rock shows early, off in the distance.

The road comes down to the Dan River at Danbury, the Stokes County seat, then swings back west for a full loop around the foot of Pilot Mountain. The Saura called that peak Jomeokee, the Great Guide. The settlers who came after took the same hint and named it Pilot.

moments.title: Hanging Rock State Park
moments.text: The outcrop that names the park is one of the quartzite knobs left standing when the softer rock around them wore away, and it is in view from the start of the byway.

moments.title: Moratock Iron Furnace
moments.text: Nathaniel Moody's granite furnace of 1843 made swords and munitions for the Confederacy until Stoneman's cavalry wrecked most of the works in 1865, and the furnace still stands in Moratock Park.

moments.title: Pilot Mountain
moments.text: The byway circles the base of the mountain, and the Big Pinnacle turns with it, bare rock walls under a rounded green top ringed with Catawba rhododendron.
